objective: Define deterministic category/state funnel segmentation from CAT-owned immutable visibility dimension snapshots without joining mutable current catalog state or changing A09 identity/linkage authority.

rootCause.currentGap: A09 behavioral stages carry service_id but not an immutable category/state snapshot, so joining public.services at query time would rewrite historical funnel dimensions.
rootCause.canonicalSource: CAT-A06 already freezes category/state dimensions on append-only listing visibility/version transitions and CAT-A07 provides the forward complete-coverage epoch.
rootCause.identityBoundary: Segmentation enriches an already explicit service_id journey; it must not create actor, anonymous, cross-session or temporal-heuristic identity linkage.

anchorSemantics.searchCtr: dimension snapshot resolved for the canonical impression identified by search_request_id + service_id
anchorSemantics.strictJourney: dimension snapshot resolved for the first canonical impression in analytics_session_id + service_id
anchorSemantics.downstreamStages: inherit the impression anchor segment for the whole strict journey even if CAT dimensions change later
anchorSemantics.finalOrderStage: inherits the journey anchor; order_id remains the only behavior-to-ORD linkage and ORD/current service dimensions never remap the segment

resolution.key: explicit service_id plus CAT-A06 visibility interval containing impression occurred_at
resolution.intervalState: latest structurally valid per-service sequence whose occurred_at is <= anchor occurred_at

authoritativeSegmentedWindowRequires: CAT ledger structural validity is preserved
CAT dependency watermark covers the selected window
every authoritative strict journey anchor resolves exactly one eligible CAT frozen segment
coverageAndFreshness.unresolvedSegmentEffect: segmented projection unavailable; global A09 projection remains independently governed

categoryIdentityContinuity.authoritySource: ANA-A11 already-certified CAT-frozen category identity semantics

nextGate: Prepare a separately authorized forward-only A09 segmentation runtime candidate that reads CAT-A06/A07 facts server-side, adds CAT to segmented dataThrough, and proves coverage/version-split/category-identity behavior in staging before any segmented snapshot publication.

maturity.reason: Repository-only immutable segmentation semantics close the design ambiguity but add no runtime/staging evidence; ANA remains 3/6.
